author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
At Authority Main `1d8e17e9c19356062d89c37f6881c6fac467ecf5` / tree `3eb6ef10b9ada5bd0c8976839b1a739ca344ac69`, the existing reflexive watchdog fetches the first 100 exact-head runs and then makes one jobs GET for every returned run without checking `total_count` or a request budget. The authorized quota repair in workspace tasks `a63ec5b1-8d42-4f64-a5a2-95a250e5b7df` and `c9ebfc7e-53c6-4ca4-bf17-2c3991acb58a` remains missing in this source.

The existing workflow body reproduces excessive/incomplete collection for 21 runs, a 100-of-101 run page and a 3-of-4 run page in isolated REST fixtures. A prepared correction extends the existing controller and workflow; 26 targeted tests pass, and the same three cases fail against the original workflow.

Bounded source acceptance:
- Validate a complete, exact-head run inventory before any per-run jobs GET.
- Admit at most 20 job requests, with zero job requests when incomplete or over budget; retain HOLD and UNKNOWN progress instead of sampling success.
- Stop on HTTP 403 without an automatic retry.
- Exercise the actual workflow body for blocked cases, the normal 0/3/20-run cases, and denials; run full make test and integrity validation.

Closing this issue means this source repair has been integrated and verified. Live push, PR459's unresolved tree publication, the original Mirror tool, original SSO/host input delivery, raumzeitterminal.de TLS and productive EFFECT_ACK_DONE remain separate open duties. No new executor or timer is requested.

Human requirements and authorization: Ingolf Lohmann. Analysis, source correction and isolated verification: OpenAI Codex.
title: Bound watchdog per-run job reads before incomplete or over-budget observation
